name: Highskills Quotation
css: .print-format { font-size: 10pt; } .print-format table.table-bordered th, .print-format table.table-bordered td { padding: 6px 8px; vertical-align: top; } .print-format tr { page-break-inside: avoid; } .print-format .term-breakdown { color: #666; font-size: 0.85em; margin-top: 2px; } .print-format .item-description { color: #666; font-size: 0.85em; margin-top: 2px; } .print-format .totals-table td { padding: 3px 8px; } .print-format .totals-table .grand-total-row td { font-weight: bold; border-top: 1px solid #333; padding-top: 6px; } .print-format .items-table thead th { border-top: 1.5px solid #1c1b19; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #1c1b19; font-weight: bold; } .print-format .sig-line { display: inline-block; width: 160px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c1b19; margin: 0 6px; }
